notes.title: Super Tony Land is now in Beta!
notes.content:
Wow, thanks for your patience waiting for this update. Here’s a list of additions, changes and fixes:

[b]Blocks:[/b]
Core Block
Chain Platform
Shadow Block
45d Ramp
Fire Block

[b]Monsters[/b]
Floating Skull
Floating Dummy Head
Koi (fishman)
Super Gamekid
Normish Kami
Normish Knight

[b]Tronics[/b]
Tronic Gravity
Tronic Coin
Tronic OnScreen
Tronic Power
Tronic Function and Function Call

[b]Items[/b]
Bubbles
Bullet
Giant Fireball
Meeple
Pie

[b]Powerups[/b]
PieMaster powerup
Star Hat powerup
Taco powerup

[b]Other Stuff[/b]
Added a Boss power meter for boss fights
Tronic NPC added Vanish
Tronic Color changes to match type
Major Chain fix
Audio Video Menu merge
Added volume control
Added a bunch of Kickstarter Content!
